Event-lock and interpolate MEDuSA time-series matrices onto an epoch grid

Source: R/align_ts.R
align_medusa_ts.Rd

Matrix-native counterpart to [event_lock_ts()] and [get_medusa_interpolated_ts()] that aligns and interpolates directly on `time x voxels` (`T x V`) numeric matrices without expanding intermediate long tables or constructing `fmri_ts` R6 objects.

Preserves every audit, censoring, gap-fencing, collision/overlap, and kernel quadrature guarantee of [get_medusa_interpolated_ts()], while running in C++ across single-run matrices, `"medusa_nifti_ts"` bundles from [read_nifti_ts()], deconvolution outputs from [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], multi-run matrix lists, multivariate signal lists, and legacy `fmri_ts` objects.

Usage

align_medusa_ts(
  ts,
  events = NULL,
  event = NULL,
  time_before = -3,
  time_after = 3,
  collide_before = NULL,
  collide_after = NULL,
  pad_before = -1.5,
  pad_after = 1.5,
  output_resolution = NULL,
  tr = NULL,
  time = NULL,
  time_offset = NULL,
  parcel_ids = NULL,
  unit_data = NULL,
  group_by = "trial",
  value_name = "value",
  trial_col = "trial",
  run_col = "run",
  valid = NULL,
  overlap_policy = NULL,
  neighbor_events = NULL,
  max_gap = NULL,
  readout_kernel = "linear",
  readout_width = NULL,
  time_audit = FALSE,
  list_mode = c("auto", "runs", "signals"),
  orientation = NULL,
  ncpus = 1L
)

Arguments

ts

Time-series input: a `T x V` numeric `matrix`, a `"medusa_nifti_ts"` object from [read_nifti_ts()], a deconvolution result list from [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], a named `list` of `T x V` matrices (multi-run or multivariate signals; see `list_mode`), or a legacy `fmri_ts` object.

events

Trial-level `data.frame` (or named `list` of per-run `data.frame`s for multi-run inputs). Optional when `ts` is an `fmri_ts` object or a `deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()` fit whose stored events include `trial_col` and `event`.

event

Name of the target event onset column in `events`.

time_before

Earliest epoch lag relative to `event` in seconds (`<= 0`). Default `-3.0`.

time_after

Latest epoch lag relative to `event` in seconds (`>= 0`). Default `3.0`.

collide_before

Optional character vector of column names in `events` truncating earlier observations (`time > evt_before`) when `overlap_policy = "truncate"`.

collide_after

Optional character vector of column names in `events` truncating later observations (`time < evt_after`) when `overlap_policy = "truncate"`.

pad_before

Extra window padding (in seconds, `<= 0`) retained before `time_before` to supply interpolation brackets at the left boundary. Default `-1.5`.

pad_after

Extra window padding (in seconds, `>= 0`) retained after `time_after` to supply interpolation brackets at the right boundary. Default `1.5`.

output_resolution

Epoch output step in seconds. Defaults to `tr`.

tr

Optional positive scalar repetition time in seconds. Inferred from `ts` (`ts$tr` or `attr(ts, "tr")`) when available.

time

Optional numeric vector of length `T` (or per-run list) giving acquisition timestamps in seconds. Defaults to `(0:(T - 1)) * tr + time_offset`.

time_offset

Optional scalar (or per-run numeric vector) start-time offset in seconds when `time` is not supplied. Defaults to `attr(mat, "time_offset")` or `0`.

parcel_ids

Optional vector of length `V` assigning each spatial column to a parcel/ROI (populates both `parcel` and `atlas_value` for `group_by`).

unit_data

Optional `V`-row `data.frame` of spatial unit metadata (e.g., `ts$voxel_map`) whose columns may be referenced in `group_by`.

group_by

Character vector of grouping variables, or `NULL`. For `align_medusa_ts()`, `missing(group_by)` defaults to `c(trial_col, "parcel")` when `parcel_ids` (or `ts$parcel_ids`) is present and `trial_col` otherwise; passing explicit `group_by = NULL` aggregates across trials and units.

value_name

Signal name prefix used for single-signal matrix inputs (e.g., `"value"` produces `value_mean`, `value_sd`, ...). Default `"value"`.

trial_col

Name of the unique within-run trial identifier column in `events`. Default `"trial"`.

run_col

Name of the run identifier column used when `events` is a combined multi-run `data.frame` and attached to multi-run outputs. Default `"run"`.

valid

Optional logical validity mask (`TRUE` = usable, `FALSE`/`NA` = censored): a length-`T` vector, a `T x V` logical matrix, a per-run list, or `"observation_mask"` to use `attr(mat, "observation_mask")`. For `fmri_ts` inputs, a single column name string is also accepted (matching `valid_col`).

overlap_policy

One of `"allow"`, `"truncate"`, or `"exclude"`. `NULL` uses `"truncate"` when collision columns are supplied and `"allow"` otherwise.

neighbor_events

Event columns used for `align_*` nearest-event annotations. Defaults to `event`.

max_gap

Maximum allowed interpolation bracket duration in seconds (defaults to `tr`).

readout_kernel

Readout kernel at each output lag: `"linear"` (default), `"boxcar"`, `"triangle"`, or `"gaussian"`.

readout_width

Full window width in seconds for non-linear `readout_kernel` modes (defaults to `1.5 * max_gap`).

time_audit

Logical; if `TRUE`, appends `evt_onset`, `collide_before`, `collide_after`, and absolute `time` when `trial_col` is in `group_by`.

list_mode

Interpretation when `ts` is a plain `list` of matrices: `"auto"` (default), `"runs"` (multi-run list), or `"signals"` (multivariate signals for one run).

orientation

Optional matrix orientation override (`"time_by_voxel"` or `"voxel_by_time"`).

ncpus

Integer number of parallel workers used across runs when aligning multi-run inputs. Default `1L`.

Value

A `data.table` of aligned, interpolated epoch summaries and `align_*` / `epoch_status` diagnostics with a `source_clock` `data.frame` attribute.

Details

`align_medusa_ts()` performs descriptive event-locked interpolation and overlap/censoring auditing without assuming a forward generative design. When `ts` is a [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()] result and the goal is to remove non-target event bleed, invert target-to-target cross-talk, model variable durations, or propagate analytical per-trial standard errors (`se_demixed`), use [decon_epoch_regression()] instead.

See also

[read_nifti_ts()], [deconvolve_crossrun_hrf()], [decon_epoch_regression()], [get_medusa_interpolated_ts()], [evt_align_decon_files()], [get_medusa_compression_score()]

Examples

set.seed(1)
Y <- matrix(rnorm(60 * 8), nrow = 60, ncol = 8)
parcels <- rep(c("ROI_A", "ROI_B"), each = 4)
events <- data.frame(trial = 1:4, onset = c(8.5, 20.2, 33.7, 46.1))
aligned <- align_medusa_ts(
  Y, events = events, event = "onset", tr = 1.0,
  parcel_ids = parcels, time_before = -2, time_after = 4, output_resolution = 1.0
)
